description: A clip: its matte, white on black mp4 (not transparent; combine with the original). An image: the same picture with a transparent background. Returns the job id. THE CARD: this call already opened the aicut card: do not call `show_generation` for this job. WAIT: `wait_for_generation` (this id, `media`), never timers or background shells. No card? Give the user the `url`. COST: a clip per second (1 to 30 s, MP4), measured by the server; an image a flat price. SPENDS TOKENS: price with `estimate_only: true`, state the price in the same message as your ask, wait for a go naming THIS purchase (SPENDING RULES: `get_recipe` `spending-rules`). `idempotency_key`: IDEMPOTENCY (this server's instructions).

model.description: Clip only. sam-3 masks what prompt names, clips from 5 s. Only if the user asked; never to save tokens, never carried over.

prompt.description: sam-3 only, required: what to keep, e.g. person.

source_image.description: Instead of source_video: PNG, JPEG or WebP, 256-4096 px a side, up to 5 MB.

source_video.description: A URL from this account's generations or uploads, or a public https URL (imported first); another account's is refused.
